title: Ai

title: Security
notes: Surfaces as forbidden/masked/read-only UI state; enforcement itself is server-side.

title: Scope
notes: Governs which tenant/company/branch/record context the UI operates within, not a screen of its own.

title: Concurrency
notes: Surfaces as stale/conflict UI state; the locking/versioning mechanism itself is server-side.

title: Idempotency
notes: Surfaces as in-flight/disabled submit state to prevent duplicate action; the replay-key mechanism itself is server-side.

title: Integrations
notes: External-system contract; no direct end-user screen unless a specific dossier (e.g. SP025) calls for an admin configuration UI.

title: Api
notes: API/transport contract requirement; consumed by the UI but is not itself a UI decision.

title: Mobile
notes: Defines the mobile support classification (full/field-optimized/approval-only/read-only/not-applicable) that other DIRECT_UI rows inherit, not a screen of its own.

title: Responsive
notes: Defines desktop/tablet/phone adaptation rules inherited by other DIRECT_UI rows, not a screen of its own.

title: Accessibility
notes: Governs HOW every UI surface must behave (keyboard/focus/contrast/motion/etc.); see SP032's own dedicated rows for the concrete acceptance contract this drives in packages/ui-web.

title: Visual Evidence
notes: Process requirement to produce wireframes/state diagrams BEFORE implementation; the requirement is procedural, not itself a UI surface.

title: Performance
notes: Surfaces as loading/skeleton/virtualization behavior, not a distinct screen.

title: Observability
notes: Telemetry/logging requirement; operator-facing only via SP030 diagnostics surfaces.

title: Edge Cases
notes: Informs which error/edge states the UI must handle, not a screen of its own.
